sections.heading: Definition
sections.body: Personal finance is how you manage your money: earning, spending, saving, and investing. In the Philippines, this often includes supporting family (breadwinner), managing remittances (OFW), and planning for goals like education, housing, and retirement.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: Good habits help you build an emergency fund, pay off debt, and reach goals without stress. PH-specific challenges include inflation (often 3–5%), peso volatility, and family financial responsibilities.
